rv.q: The hilarious Avenue Q tells the timeless story of a recent college graduate trying to find his way in the world.
"Avenue Q the musical" will continue thru August 7th with performances as follows: Fridays 7:30 p.m.

cn.t: This Tony-winning musical comedy blends puppets with adult themes in an "X-rated Sesame Street" format, following a college grad navigating life and finding his place in an unaffordable New York.
